LanguageData.BOR_GameOfUrBoard.label: game-of-ur holoboard
LanguageData.BOR_GameOfUrBoard.description: Dating from 2500BC, this exciting yet infuriating board game can be played by one or two people. This particular board is enhanced with holo-projectors capable of making the game more engaging and/or challenging, alongside allowing for a single player to play against a Computerized opponent. It trains intellectual skills.
LanguageData.BOR_ChessTable.label: chess holotable
LanguageData.BOR_ChessTable.description:
A high-tech version of this most ancient board game with an onboard Artificial Intelligence and holo-projectors. It trains intellectual skills.
This building requires adjacent chairs or stools to use.
LanguageData.BOR_PokerTable.label: poker holotable
LanguageData.BOR_PokerTable.description:
A highly advanced table designed for gambling and playing card games like poker. It has been enhanced with holographic technology to improve the user experience, removing the need for physical cards.
This building requires adjacent chairs or stools to use.
LanguageData.BOR_BilliardsTable.label: billiards holotable
LanguageData.BOR_BilliardsTable.description: A highly advanced pool table designed to play a variety of games such as billiards utilizing holographic projectors. It trains shooting ability.
LanguageData.BOR_MegascreenTelevision_I.label: solarscreen television
LanguageData.BOR_MegascreenTelevision_I.description: A massive high-tech television. Gigantic, hyper-vibrant images almost leap out of the screen. Very entertaining. Capable of picking up transmissions from most sources within the cosmos.
LanguageData.BOR_Telescope_I.label: holotelescope
LanguageData.BOR_Telescope_I.description: An advanced telescope that provides a clear enough picture for Professional astronomy. It's a relaxing hobby for a certain kind of person. Can only be used outdoors.
LanguageData.BOR_PC_I.label: solarite personal computer
LanguageData.BOR_PC_I.description: A high tech computer utilizing Sunsteel to vastly improve its performance, capable of running Crysis 2 on max settings for a whole half hour without overheating. Gives a boost to learning after use.
